Fgf0BaselineRevisionElement is a facade object in Active Workspace and its corresponding persistent object is Mdl0BaselineRevision. Fgf0BaselineRevisionElement contains revision-specific properties of a revision of Mdl0Baseline. Fgf0BaselineRevisionElement is used as a stable snapshot of the 4GD product, it do not form structures and intended to be used by 4G applications only. Fgf0BaselineRevisionElement is session recoverable object.

The Build Condition Element is a business object used for presentation that wraps an underlying build condition object. A build condition object holds a variant formula string that Teamcenter Configurator generated on a product item based on the various rules defined on the product item.

Struct.description: Criteria provide information about recipe to search occurrences in a product.

StructElement.description:
The type of search criteria represented in this structure. The list of valid values are:
    • Attribute: Indicates a property based search term
    • BoxZone: Indicates a type of spatial search term
    • PlaneZone: Indicates a type of spatial search term
    • Proximity: Indicates a type spatial search term
    • ClosureRule: Indicates a closure rule search term
    • Group: Indicates a groups of multiple search terms
    • Partition: Indicates a partition based search term
StructElement.name: criteriaType

StructElement.description: A list of internal values used within this search term.
StructElement.name: criteriaValues

StructElement.description: A user-friendly string representation of this search term.
StructElement.name: criteriaDisplayValue

StructElement.description:
The search term operator indicating the logic for combining this search term. The list of valid values are:
    • Include (OR)
    • Filter (AND)
    • Exclude (NOT)
StructElement.name: criteriaOperatorType

StructElement.description: A grouping of multiple search terms. This will be empty if the recipe contains no groups.
